title: Diptych with Targets and Chess 3
description: Gallery view of two framed works hung side by side against a taupe wall. Left panel features sparse ivory ground with chess piece, target motifs, and gestural marks; right panel is a dense collage incorporating bullseye targets, an american football, chess piece, and layered ephemera in warm browns, greens, and whites.
composition: two framed works side by side
